label: Whatever is maximal in being is the first being, i.e. nothing other than it…, by… (2)
meaning: Suppose something other than a maximum is simply prior to it. The priority bridge makes it an actual concretum, so the world is inhabited and a necessary root exists, identical with that maximum by necessaryRootIsMaximum. The prior thing is then an actual concrete ground of a root, which is absurd; excluded middle gives identity.
